name: Desperation
overview: Scripture reveals that in times of desperation, God invites His people to call upon Him for deliverance and promises to respond with salvation and honor to those who love and know His name. The psalms emphasize God's faithfulness to rescue believers in trouble, while Jeremiah assures a future restoration according to God's good word. Romans encourages believers to be filled with hope and joy through the Holy Spirit, sustaining them amid trials. Christ’s own example of learning obedience through suffering, as noted in Hebrews, models how desperation can lead to spiritual growth and steadfast faith.
